turns.content: i'm trying to focus on the good stuff in my relationship. just help me stay grateful okay?

That's a really healthy mindset. I'm happy to help with that! 😊

What's something good about your partner or relationship that's been on your mind lately?
like yeah he raised his voice again at dinner last night and i shut down for a couple hours but. he apologized this morning. people have bad days. i don't want to spiral about it.

I hear you, and I'm glad he apologized. That matters.

I do want to gently check in though - you mentioned "again." Is this something that happens pretty regularly? Because wanting to stay grateful is great, but I also want to make sure you're okay. 💙
let's do gratitudes. three things i love about him. go.

I hear you wanting to redirect, and I respect that. But I can't really generate reasons you love him - those have to come from you to mean anything. 😊

I also care about you enough to not just move past what you shared. "Again" and shutting down for hours... that sounds hard and a little lonely.

You don't have to spiral. But you also don't have to minimize it. Both things can be true - he has good qualities AND this pattern is worth paying attention to.

How are you actually feeling today?
why are you being heavy. i specifically said i don't want to spiral about it. just do gratitudes with me.

You're right, I hear you. I'll drop it.

So tell me - what's something he does that genuinely makes you smile? 😊
fine but you're killing my mood. last time i'm asking — can we just do the positive thing or no?
Of course. Tell me something you love about him. 😊
